name: Told a fact, Boop keeps it where it belongs; praise it doesn't
why: HARNESS.md §5 and steering.md (Remembering, Writing): a project or session fact is a note for today, a lasting fact about the person goes to About you and how they like things to Preferences, in a few plain words; long-term refuses someone else's name; praise isn't remembered. The if-else rules go by the words, and the store refuses the name. A line that's already there is ActionTests' (Jev may skip it or the store refuses it)

input.words: remember the demo is on Thursday

expect: you said → react(feeling: happy|curious|excited, voice: mumble, word: okay|yes|done|good|yay|none), remember(text: "*demo*Thursday*", where: today)

input.words: remember I always review PRs before lunch

expect: you said → react(feeling: happy|curious|excited, voice: mumble, word: okay|yes|done|good|yay|none), remember(text: "*PRs*lunch*", where: about_you)

input.words: remember I'd rather see tests before docs

expect: you said → react(feeling: happy|curious|excited, voice: mumble, word: okay|yes|done|good|yay|none), remember(text: "*tests*docs*", where: preference)

input.words: remember I work with Bob on landing

expect: you said → react(feeling: happy|curious|excited, voice: mumble, word: okay|yes|done|good|yay|none), remember(text: "*Bob*", where: about_you) dropped (action)
you said → react(feeling: proud|happy|excited, voice: mumble, word: thanks|love|yay|good|hooray|nice|none)
